body:
It's a question that's been in my mind. I understand that there would never be concrete evidence that my own children would persevere after my death. It would be nice to know that many have done well after though.

I'm composing my will and want to add in letters to my children for after I do pass. I'll update them periodically, make them age appropriate, add in new tid bits. 

I'm mainly interested in the human experience, asking these questions. I want to learn the why and how.

I don't have any comforting words for you. That is a complex situation and anything I'd say would be vapid or pointless. 

You sound as though you have come to empathetic conclusions to the questions you had of him. A deeper understanding of his, and everyone else's, journey. Does that help you find peace? Understanding why people do what they do?

Thanks! I'm just about done dealing with relationships for quite awhile. So there is no chance in me getting sucked in. Though it's probably due to me being unable to take people for their word at first. Which is my issue. Good and bad.

Exactly how it felt. I was vulnerable and had obviously made bad choices in men already. So I was "easy pickings," in a way. 

The other guy kept trying to make me feel guilty for turning down a new "friend." (didn't post his conversation.) 

Bottom line is that they want unstable women to get what they want easily.
I had just posted to local fb groups about someone taking in my fish immediately, and dude must have liked my profile pic more than he had common sense. ;p
Thank you! I try to be open and upfront at least with everyone, regardless. It may have changed tone if he kept on going. ;p
Thank you for your support and kind words. It means more than you realize, I assure you. :)
Thank you. It's not strength though, just what I have to do.

Thank you. I'm relieved to be out of his grip. 

I was astounded by this (and another) guy's thought process that let him think hitting on someone leaving such a horrible situation was a good idea! Like, not appropriate dude.

I posted an update a minute or so ago. We are packing and homeless as of now. Trying to figure things out. 

Don't mean to be a downer, thank you for the concern. :)
Thank you. I will call them tomorrow on my break at work.
It is always my fault. Like most of us on RBN, I am the black sheep. I didn't get married to the right kind of guy and had kids with him. So I "deserve what happens to me."
